recentItems.title: Defence Team News | Search and rescue without borders
recentItems.description:
Search and rescue doesn't stop at international borders.

During this year’s Advanced Search and Rescue Exercise (ASAREX), Canadian Armed Forces members joined international partners in the Azores to strengthen cooperation, share best practices, and train for complex maritime rescue scenarios.

Watch how international teamwork helps ensure responders are ready when lives are on the line. 🌎

recentItems.title: 60 Seconds with S1 Murphy: Life as a Weapons Engineering Technician
recentItems.description: From working high atop a ship's mast to visiting ports around the world, S1 Murphy gives us an overview of the exciting world of Weapons Engineering Technicians, all in 60 Seconds.

recentItems.title: 60 Seconds with Major Isabelle Delorme on Tactical Aviation Intelligence
recentItems.description: Turning information into action. Major Isabelle Delorme takes us inside the world of Tactical Aviation Intelligence and the crucial role it plays in supporting Royal Canadian Air Force operations.

recentItems.title: Defence Team News | CAF at the Royal Nova Scotia International Tattoo
recentItems.description:
More than 200 Canadian Armed Forces members took part in this year's Royal Nova Scotia International Tattoo, joining military and civilian performers from around the world in a celebration of service, heritage, and culture.

The event also marked a special milestone with cadets and musicians from the Royal Military College of Canada participating during the institution's 150th anniversary year.

En français : https://youtu.be/02ke8iTYWBw
